body:
This is the first time I have ever tried any sort of opiate, and I was excited as hell because I did my research and knew what they were capable of.  So I got a hold of some Oxycontin, and I figured since I have never done it before and have no opiate tolerance that I would only need a few.
So at 1:05am I took 2 10mg CR pills, and made sure that nothing else was in my system so I could get the full effect of this specific drug. I also cracked them in half since it was 'Controlled Release'.  As I sat in my room waiting for sweet sweet euphoria I began to get a little annoyed because it had been 30 minutes and nothing was happening.  Then at around 2am I took 2 more which is 40mg all together in hopes that I would get something out of it. But all I could feel was a slight buzz throughout my body and my hands and legs itched.
After it had been an hour since my last 2 I was quite pissed off, I was feeling absolutely nothing except this incessant itching that got worse and worse.  I could not stop scratching my chest, hands, and legs, it was very awkward but thankfully there were no bumps or markings that meant it was an allergic reaction. After a while I began to think that maybe just the cracking wasn't enough, and that perhaps I should have crushed them entirely, because the slight buzz I continued to feel throughout the night was definitely noticeable but obviously not the euphoria that is so desired. And though I tried to make sure to eat plenty and drink milk afterward, my stomach was definitely weak. And every time I stood up I wanted to puke.  So I made sure to lie down and I was safe.
Overall it was a total waste of some perfectly good Oxy, but I will definitely try it again this time making damn sure it is 100% crushed, other than that I have no clue how I could have withstood 40mg in my opiate virgin body.
